title: Anthropic Files for IPO, Revealing Soaring Revenue and Massive Losses
en: U.S. artificial intelligence company Anthropic publicly filed its prospectus for an initial public offering on Monday, in a debut that could become the largest in stock market history. The registration statement filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission set neither the number of shares nor a price range. Anthropic intends to list its Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker symbol ANT, with Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley leading 24 underwriters. Revenue reached $16.29 billion in the first half of 2026, up from $1.16 billion a year earlier, while the net loss widened to $80.7 billion, mostly from revaluing its convertible notes. Computing power remains the central cost: the company spent nearly $9 billion in the half and has committed $518 billion to future infrastructure.
zh: 美国人工智能公司Anthropic于周一公开提交首次公开募股（IPO）招股说明书，此次上市有望成为股市历史上规模最大的一次。这份向美国证券交易委员会提交的注册声明既未确定发行股数，也未确定价格区间。Anthropic计划在纳斯达克全球精选市场上市其A类普通股，股票代码为“ANT”，由高盛和摩根士丹利领衔，共24家机构参与承销。公司2026年上半年营收达162.9亿美元，高于上年同期的11.6亿美元；净亏损扩大至807亿美元，主要来自可转换票据的重新估值。算力仍是最核心的成本：上半年公司相关支出接近90亿美元，并已承诺未来投入5180亿美元用于基础设施建设。
vocab: n. 首次登台；（此处）首次上市

title: Lula Wins Historic Fourth Term as Flavio Bolsonaro Refuses to Concede
en: Brazil's electoral court said President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva has won a historic fourth term, a shock result that defied the polls and halted a wave of right-wing election victories across Latin America. The 80-year-old incumbent took about 51.8% of valid votes in Sunday's runoff, beating Senator Flavio Bolsonaro, eldest son of the jailed former president, by more than 4 million votes after trailing him in the first round. It was the first time since Brazil's return to democracy that a candidate trailing after round one went on to win the runoff. Flavio refused to concede, saying he would seek the annulment of the result. Financial markets that had bet on a right-wing victory were rattled: an exchange-traded fund tracking the Bovespa index dived nearly 15% in Tokyo trade, while the real was set to slide against the dollar.
zh: 巴西选举法院宣布，总统卢拉赢得史无前例的第四个任期。这一结果出乎民调意料，也挡住了席卷拉美的右翼胜选浪潮。这位80岁的现任总统在周日决胜轮投票中获得约51.8%的有效票，击败参议员弗拉维奥·博索纳罗——这位被监禁的前总统的长子曾在首轮领先，最终却以逾400万票之差落败。这是巴西回归民主以来，首次有候选人在首轮落后的情况下于决胜轮逆转取胜。弗拉维奥拒绝认输，称将寻求撤销本次选举结果。此前押注右翼获胜的金融市场受到震动：追踪巴西圣保罗指数的交易所交易基金在东京交易时段暴跌近15%，雷亚尔兑美元也面临大幅下挫。

title: Diplomacy Lifts Hopes of Mideast De-escalation, Dragging Oil Lower
en: Senior officials from Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan travelled to Tehran on Monday for talks aimed at de-escalating the Middle East conflict, and the four states agreed to continue discussions on strengthening regional peace and security. It was the first high-level contact between Iran and the three signatories of the Mecca mutual defence pact since the war spread to Saudi Arabia and Yemen. Saudi Arabia, represented by its defence minister, said the visit aimed to open negotiating channels to prevent a return to military escalation. Pakistani mediators have meanwhile pushed a proposal under which Iran would reopen the Strait of Hormuz to commercial shipping while the United States lifts its blockade of Iranian ports. Oil fell for a second day as the diplomacy offered hope: West Texas Intermediate dropped toward $101 a barrel, while Brent slipped below $116.
zh: 沙特、土耳其和巴基斯坦高级官员周一前往德黑兰，就缓和中东冲突举行会谈，四方同意继续磋商，以加强地区和平与安全领域的合作。这是自战火蔓延至沙特和也门以来，伊朗与《麦加共同防务协议》三个签署国之间的首次高层接触。沙特由国防大臣哈立德·本·萨勒曼亲王代表出席，表示此行意在开启谈判渠道，防止军事冲突再度升级。与此同时，巴基斯坦调解方一直在推动一项方案：伊朗重新开放霍尔木兹海峡允许商船通行，作为交换，美国解除对伊朗港口的海上封锁。随着外交努力带来缓和希望，油价连续第二个交易日下跌，西得州中质原油跌至每桶101美元附近，布伦特原油则回落至116美元以下。

title: Fed Seen Holding Rates This Week as Investors Price a December Hike
en: The Federal Reserve is expected to leave interest rates unchanged at the conclusion of its two-day meeting on October 28, even as higher energy costs complicate the inflation outlook. The consumer price index rose again in September, lifting the annual inflation rate to 3.7%, while surging oil prices linked to the US war with Iran pushed producer prices higher. Fed funds futures last priced in less than a 10% chance of another quarter-point hike this week, according to CME's FedWatch tool, though nearly three quarters of investors expect at least one increase before year-end. The central bank lifted its benchmark rate to a range of 3.75% to 4% last month, its first hike since 2023. The meeting falls less than two weeks before the US midterm elections, a factor several economists say argues for patience.
zh: 美联储预计将在10月28日结束的为期两天的议息会议后维持利率不变，尽管能源成本上升令通胀前景变得更加复杂。美国9月消费者价格指数再度上行，推动年通胀率升至3.7%；与此同时，与对伊朗战事相关的油价飙升，也在推高生产者价格。芝加哥商品交易所“美联储观察”工具显示，联邦基金期货对本周再加息25个基点的定价不足10%，但接近四分之三的投资者预计年底前至少还会有一次加息。美联储上月将基准利率上调至3.75%至4%的区间，为2023年以来首次加息。此次会议距美国中期选举不足两周，多位经济学家认为，这一因素也支持美联储保持耐心。
vocab: n. 25个基点，四分之一个百分点

title: Meta Plans Record US$95 Billion Equity Raise to Fund AI Expansion
en: Meta Platforms said on Monday it plans to raise up to US$95 billion in its largest-ever equity fundraising, as it spends aggressively on costly artificial intelligence infrastructure. It has launched public offerings worth about US$35 billion in common and preferred stock, and plans a separate at-the-market share sale programme of up to US$60 billion once its new non-voting Class C shares begin trading, expected in the first quarter of 2027. Nvidia, Advanced Micro Devices and Broadcom have expressed interest in buying up to US$5 billion of Class A shares. Because all three supply Meta's data centres, their participation has added to concerns about an increasingly circular flow of capital in the AI industry. Meta reported a US$2.12 billion cash burn in the third quarter and lifted its full-year capital spending forecast to between US$135 billion and US$145 billion.
zh: Meta Platforms周一表示，计划通过史上规模最大的一次股权融资筹集至多950亿美元，以支持其昂贵的人工智能基础设施巨额支出。公司已启动规模约350亿美元的普通股与优先股公开发行，并计划在新增的无投票权C类股票开始交易（预计为2027年第一季度）后，另行推出至多600亿美元的按市价股票发售计划。英伟达、超微半导体（AMD）和博通已表示有意认购至多50亿美元的A类普通股。由于这三家公司均为Meta数据中心供应设备，其参与进一步加剧了外界对人工智能行业资本循环流动的担忧。Meta第三季度录得21.2亿美元的现金净流出，并将全年资本开支预测上调至1350亿至1450亿美元之间。

title: China's Combined Wind and Solar Capacity Exceeds 2 Billion Kilowatts
en: China's combined wind and solar power capacity surpassed 2 billion kilowatts by the end of September, the National Energy Administration said on Monday, further consolidating the country's position at the top of the global clean-energy supply chain. Total power generation capacity reached 4.13 billion kilowatts, up 11.2% year on year, including 1.31 billion kilowatts of solar, up 16.5%, and 700 million kilowatts of wind, up 20.4%. Between January and September the two sources generated 1,933.3 billion kilowatt-hours of electricity, 193.7 billion more than a year earlier, meeting 64% of the country's increase in electricity consumption. Officials said renewables have become the main force driving the energy transition and a key pillar of energy security, contributing roughly one third of total energy investment over the period.
zh: 国家能源局26日表示，截至9月底，中国风电和太阳能发电累计装机容量合计已突破20亿千瓦，进一步巩固了我国在全球清洁能源产业链中的领先地位。全国累计发电装机容量达41.3亿千瓦，同比增长11.2%，其中太阳能发电装机13.1亿千瓦、同比增长16.5%，风电装机7亿千瓦、同比增长20.4%。1至9月，风电和太阳能发电量达19333亿千瓦时，比上年同期增加1937亿千瓦时，占全社会新增用电量的64%。有关部门表示，新能源已成为推进能源转型的主要力量和保障能源安全的关键支柱，同期风电与太阳能发电投资约占能源领域完成投资额的三分之一。
vocab: adv. 同比，与上年同期相比
